Reference / terminal/width

terminal/width#

How many columns text takes on a terminal, by grapheme cluster: wide East Asian characters and emoji take two, combining marks none.

Version: v1.0.0

Synopsis#

DisplayWidth("日本").columns();                        // 4
TruncatedDisplay(origin: title, width: 20, ellipsis: "…").string();
WrappedDisplay(origin: paragraph, width: 72).string();

Description#

How many columns text takes on a terminal, by grapheme cluster: wide East Asian characters and emoji take two, combining marks none.

Control characters are refused with InvalidDisplayText.
